item.tib: bla ma gru chen po'i rnam thar
item.coloph: bla ma'i rnam thar nu (nor) bu chu dngas 'di/ rjes 'brang rnams kyi dang (dwangs) ba skyed (bskyed) phyir du/ slob dpon lha dgod/ slob dpon ye shes 'bum/ drang srong yid bzhin ston pa g.yung drung rtsug (gtsug) dang nye nas la swogs blo gsal stus nas mtha' bzhi'i 'dul seng bdag gis dkar chag yi ger btab//
